profile.headline: Co-Founder & CTO at Lumio | Building AI for Self Storage | ex-Amazon
profile.summary: Sell the problem you solve, not the product.

positions.title: Co-Founder & CTO
positions.description: Lumio helps storage operators automate up to 90% of inbound calls with voice agents that know their facilities, follow their rules, and integrate directly with their facility management systems. Never miss a lead, reduce call center costs, and give tenants instant, 24/7 support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on the Sponsored Brands Auction Team which has developed an independent ad server to rank and price branded ads for Amazon search.

positions.title: CTO & Co-Founder
positions.description: Flutter is a dating app that works exclusively on Sundays, with fleeting matches and messages to encourage members to seize the moment and take their connections beyond the app. Join the mindful movement at joinflutter.com.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on our Core Foundation team, which develops and maintains all micro-services handling incoming click traffic up to the point of publishing to our attribution services. I primarily work in Node.js and Java8 with peripheral experience in our NGINX gateways and React.js dashboard.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: After backing my first company's seed round (Whatsgoodly), Highland brought me on to consult early stage consumer investments on growth and marketplace virality while I was finishing my degree at Stanford.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Whatsgoodly was an anonymous social polling app that grew to roughly 200,000 users within a few months of launching at roughly 100 college campuses nationwide.
